generatedFrom: the reference signing path of the first implementation, with a throwaway key
note: Signed with a THROWAWAY key, not a certificate. What a second implementation needs to check is the construction of the signing input, and that does not depend on who holds the key. The signingInput field is base64 of the exact UTF-8 bytes that were signed.
rules: The signing input is canonical content + LF + canonical metadata (§a.3).
Every comment line and every field except signature/timestamp is inside the signing input.
Fields are sorted by key name; comment lines keep document order.
A counter-signature covers the document INCLUDING the previous block.
signature and timestamp fall outside the signing input — the unavoidable exclusion.
